prep.notes: Filtered AED locations to Songshan, Xinyi, Daan, Zhongshan districts using corrected Taipei region codes. Excluded classifications '學校、大型集會場所' and '其他'. Merged duplicate locations by address to ensure unique sites. Generated unique site IDs 'S0'...'S(N-1)'. Computed pairwise Haversine distance matrix in meters. Corrected district code mapping based on sample data verification.
